name: get_book_status
description: Retrieves the current availability status of a specific book, indicating whether it is in stock, checked out, or reserved.

required_parameters.name: book_title
required_parameters.description: The title of the book to check the availability status for.

result_parameters.name: book_status
result_parameters.description: The current availability status of the specified book, indicating whether it is in stock, checked out, or reserved.

name: renew_books
description: Allows a user to extend the borrowing period for books currently checked out, subject to library policies and availability.

required_parameters.name: library_number
required_parameters.description: The identifier of the library account.

required_parameters.name: book_names
required_parameters.description: The names of the books to be renewed.

result_parameters.name: renewal_period
result_parameters.description: The additional amount of time granted to return the book.

result_parameters.name: total_amount_due
result_parameters.description: The total amount the user has to pay, including late fees and renewal fees.

name: reserve_book
description: Enables a user to place a reservation on a book that is currently loaned out, notifying the user when the book becomes available.

required_parameters.name: book_title
required_parameters.description: The title of the book to be reserved

required_parameters.name: card_number
required_parameters.description: The card number of the user who is reserving the book

optional_parameters.name: book_format
optional_parameters.description: The desired format of the book, e.g. hardcover, paperback, ebook etc.

name: get_late_fees
description: Calculates any late fees accrued on a user¡¯s account for books not returned by their due date, potentially offering breakdowns by book or date range.

required_parameters.name: library_ID
required_parameters.description: The unique identifier of a library user's account

result_parameters.name: late_fees
result_parameters.description: The total late fees owed by the user on their account

name: apply_for_membership
description: Facilitates the process for users to apply for a new membership with the library or bookstore, which may include online forms and submission of required documents.

required_parameters.name: city_of_residence
required_parameters.description: The city that the user currently resides in

result_parameters.name: membership_status
result_parameters.description: The status of the user's membership application

result_parameters.name: membership_fee
result_parameters.description: The cost of membership per month if the user does not reside in the library town

result_parameters.name: application_link
result_parameters.description: The link to the membership application form

name: make_payment
description: Processes payments made by users for various services, including late fees, membership fees, or purchasing books, offering multiple payment methods.

required_parameters.name: account_number
required_parameters.description: The library account number of the user making the payment.

required_parameters.name: payment_amount
required_parameters.description: The amount to be paid by the user.

required_parameters.name: payment_method
required_parameters.description: The method by which the user chooses to make the payment. Eg. Credit card, PayPal, etc.

result_parameters.name: payment_status
result_parameters.description: The status of the payment that has been attempted. Could be successful or unsuccessful.
